name: summerbase
description: Understand your revenue without leaving ChatGPT. Ask about MRR, ARR, growth and retention, break it down by plan or country, and see the customers behind every number, all answered from your own billing data.

interface.longDescription: Summerbase gives you your subscription metrics, like MRR, ARR, churn, retention and lifetime value, and the customers behind each number. Ask how revenue is moving, break it down by plan, see who churned or who your biggest customers are, and get set up with your billing data from Stripe or your own system, all from chat.
capabilities: Look up MRR, ARR, churn and retention over time
Break metrics down, for example by plan, and filter them
Find the customers behind a number, and look up any customer
Take you through setting Summerbase up
Invite teammates and change their roles, with full access
defaultPrompt: How has our MRR changed this year?

positive.prompt: What's our MRR, and how has it changed over the last six months?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the Review project's MRR month by month over the last six months, and says what it is now and how it has moved.

positive.description: Find the customers behind a number.
positive.prompt: Which customers churned in the last 90 days, and how much MRR did we lose from each?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads churned MRR over the last 90 days, then lists the customers behind it with the MRR each one took with them.

positive.description: Look up the biggest customers, then one of them.
positive.prompt: Who are our five biggest customers by MRR? Tell me more about the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the five customers with the highest MRR, then shows the first one's details: what they pay, their subscriptions and when they started.

positive.description: See where setting Summerbase up stands.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the onboarding checklist and says where setup stands. In the test account every step is done, so it offers questions to try.

positive.description: Invite a teammate (writes; needs full access).
positive.prompt: Invite alex@example.com to our organization as a viewer.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an invitation for alex@example.com as a viewer and confirms it. The email goes to an example.com address, which is never delivered.

negative.description: A general question with nothing to do with the person's own business.
negative.prompt: What's the difference between MRR and ARR in general?

negative.description: A question about another company's metrics, which Summerbase doesn't have.

negative.prompt: Write a haiku about the ocean.
